message.content:
Based on the screenshot of the Green City landing page hero section:

**1) Layout Cleanliness:** Yes, the layout is clean and well-structured. There are no overlapping elements; the left-side text content and right-side visual elements (infographic + floating cards) are clearly separated and properly spaced.

**2) Image Loading:** All images appear to be loading correctly. The recycling infographic is fully visible with clear text and icons, the small nature photo at the bottom renders properly, and all UI icons (logo, buttons, badges) display without issues.

**3) Header/Navbar:** The header looks correct and professional. It features a proper logo on the left, centered navigation links (Trang chủ, Danh mục, Khám phá, etc.), and two distinct CTA buttons (Đăng nhập / Đăng tin) aligned to the right.

**4) Floating Info Cards:** The three floating cards ("Tái chế mỗi ngày", "Kết nối mua – bán", "Thu gom tận nơi") are positioned well around the main infographic. They have good visual hierarchy with icons, bold titles, and descriptive text, creating an engaging layered effect without obscuring critical content.

**5) Visual Defects:** No significant visual defects detected. The design maintains consistent green branding, proper typography hierarchy, and balanced whitespace. The "DEMO" badge and location tag ("TP.HCM") are clearly visible. All interactive elements (buttons, links) appear properly styled.

**Overall Assessment:** This is a polished, professional-looking hero section with no apparent rendering or layout issues.
